summary: v43.76 backend test: 3 backend features validated (Pending Approvals widget + auto master_alert on havale/create; IP change flood grouping with grouped_from_5min counter; Marketplace publisher_tier badge & publisher_license removal). All 7 pytest cases PASS.

minor.issue: Slack/email gating uses recent_same==2 (only 3rd event triggers grouped notification). 4th+ events in the same 5-min window intentionally suppress delivery — this matches spec but means bursts of >3 events will only ever send ONE grouped Slack; if the flood continues past 5 minutes the window resets. Consider a secondary reminder at N=10 or window-end summary.

email_body string uses Python implicit string concatenation with 'dk''da' — the double apostrophe is a Python literal that becomes a single quote, but the intent 'dk'da' is preserved. Minor cosmetic; keep an eye on it.

critical_code_review_comments: payments.py havale_create wraps master_alerts insert in bare try/except pass — if the alert insert silently fails, the dashboard widget will lag until next scan. Consider logging the exception (log.warning) rather than swallowing.
payments.py /pending-approvals correctly excludes _id via projection; verified no ObjectId leak.
server.py idle-lock-event: recent_same is computed BEFORE insert, so grouped_from_5min values progress 0,1,2,3,... — this matches the spec ('1st has grouped_from_5min=N, each subsequent grew by 1').

server.py idle-lock-event Slack gating logic (line 2320): condition `(not is_grouped or recent_same == 2)` means: send for recent_same in {0,1,2}, skip for {3,4,...}. Effectively sends first 3 events (not just 3rd). Docstring/comment says 'sadece 3. IP değişikliğinde tek özet mesaj yolla' but the code sends all first three. Minor mismatch between intent and behaviour — either fix the comment or restrict to `recent_same == 2` only.
marketplace.py list_signatures correctly pops publisher_license before returning and enriches with publisher_tier — verified.
marketplace.py tier thresholds asc: >=5 Trusted, >=15 Expert, >=30 Elite — hierarchical ordering intact (if/elif/elif).
seed_data_creation: Test creates: (a) one havale payment (TRF... status=awaiting_transfer) which remains for the pending-approvals widget seed; (b) one master_alert of type=pending_approval; (c) four master_alerts of type=idle_lock_ip_change for a random license key MS-TEST-FLOOD-XXXXXXXX (test-scoped, does not interfere with production data). Existing 6 marketplace_signatures for MS-TESTBAYI-STARTER-V4371 remain untouched — Trusted Publisher badge verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Master alerts endpoint is /api/admin/threat-alerts (not /api/master/alerts). /api/payments/pending-approvals requires BOTH X-Master-Key AND X-Forwarded-For=MASTER_IP (strict payments guard via _require_master_payments). Other admin endpoints only need X-Master-Key. Frontend slash-command history localStorage was not tested (backend-only scope).
